name: Sasken Technologies Ltd
tagline: Sub-scale 15-year R&D-services laggard with a real 2-quarter organic inflection (Q1 FY27 revenue +24%, EBITDA margin ~2% -> ~9.5%) - but the FY26 'doubling' was the Borqs acquisition, margins are still half of peers, and after a ~2.8x re-rating the turnaround is substantially priced (~31x forward P/E)
business_overview: Sasken is a small product-engineering / embedded R&D services firm (semiconductor/chipset design, automotive, communications, satcom, plus IoT/telematics via Borqs). Historically a chronic underperformer versus Tata Elxsi / L&T Technology Services with flat revenue, sub-10% margins and tight promoter (Mody family, ~43%) control. FY26 revenue rose 102% to Rs 1,113 Cr - almost entirely the Borqs Technologies (India ops) acquisition consolidated from April 2025 (~Rs 256 Cr invested, ~Rs 173 Cr goodwill). With Borqs now in the base, Q1 FY27 organic revenue grew ~24% YoY (software services +24.3%), EBITDA margin recovered to ~9.5% off an FY25 trough, and bookings were US$47.1m (US$33.7m new, Open RAN + AI-led engineering).
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 2,900 Cr; stock ran ~2.8x off its 52-week low (range Rs 993 - 2,785)
Structurally weak (group ROE ~7-8% over 3 years); inflecting off a trough but still well below peers
Almost debt-free; high cash payout (Rs 25/share dividend FY26)
FY24 ~Rs 406 Cr -> FY25 ~Rs 551 Cr (+35%) -> FY26 Rs 1,113 Cr (+102%, Borqs consolidation); Q1 FY27 Rs 339.2 Cr, +24% YoY (now like-for-like), +1.6% QoQ; bookings US$47.1m

EBITDA margin FY24 ~7.6% -> FY25 trough (EBIT -62%) -> FY26 recovering -> Q1 FY27 9.47% (down from 9.93% QoQ; product solutions under pressure); Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 23.5 Cr (+135% YoY off a low base); FY26 PAT Rs 58.65 Cr (+16%), EPS ~Rs 38 vs FY24's Rs 52
~50x trailing / ~31x forward P/E; ~28x trailing / ~20x forward EV/EBITDA vs peers on far higher margins - the re-rating has run ahead of the fundamentals
fundamentals_narrative: There is a real operating improvement: Q1 FY27 organic revenue +24% YoY (software services +24.3%), EBITDA up 119% YoY, PAT +135%, US$47.1m of bookings led by Open RAN and AI-led engineering, five new logos. But the deep read materially tempers the earlier write-up: (1) the FY26 revenue 'doubling' to Rs 1,113 Cr was the Borqs Technologies consolidation from April 2025, not organic semiconductor-design momentum; (2) the ~9.5% EBITDA margin is a recovery off a self-inflicted FY25 trough and is still roughly half of what Tata Elxsi / LTTS earn (~20-26%), with the product-solutions segment now deteriorating; (3) FY26 EPS (~Rs 38) is still below FY24's Rs 52 four years on; (4) after a ~2.8x re-rating the stock trades at ~31x forward earnings, so the turnaround is substantially priced. No red flags - debt-free, profitable, ~43% promoter-held.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. Stock has run from ~Rs 993 to ~Rs 2,785 over 52 weeks - a completed re-rating, not a fresh breakout.
sentiment_summary: Thread 'Sasken - Not so good company but can be good investment?' (topic 614, 121 posts) is thin and long-suffering. For years the dominant view was that Sasken is a structurally weak laggard whose only realistic exit is acquisition, hamstrung by promoter control and 30%+ attrition. Since early 2025 a single retained bull (Rajesh_kumar_Singh, invested) has argued the revenue re-acceleration + heavy hiring + falling attrition signal 'the best is coming', and post-Q4 FY26 the stock delivered. Still very little independent coverage.

verdict_headline: Real 2-quarter organic inflection in a sub-scale R&D-services laggard - but the FY26 'doubling' was an acquisition, margins are half of peers, per-share earnings are still below FY24, and after a ~2.8x re-rating the turnaround is priced; downgraded to LOW-MEDIUM / 'neither'
verdict_reasoning: four_box score 2.0: tailwind and tam get the small-cap live-inflection carve-out (genuine +24% organic revenue, tripling margins off a trough, US$47m bookings), but moat is 'no' (15-year laggard, ~half of peer EBITDA margin, talent-war disadvantage) and valuation is 'no' (~31x forward / ~50x trailing P/E after a 2.8x re-rating - the turnaround is substantially priced)

The phreak growth carve-out that would permit a return-magnitude label at score 2.0-2.5 is DECLINED here: durability is unproven (product solutions deteriorating, only 2 quarters), the growth optics are inflated by the Borqs consolidation and a low FY25 base, and FY26 EPS (~Rs 38) is still below FY24's Rs 52 - so thesis_fit is 'neither'

This overrides the earlier 'recent-quarter-trend -> 10x at Medium-High' call: the recent quarters are real but (a) partly inorganic, (b) off a self-inflicted trough, and (c) already priced. Conviction cut Medium-High -> Low-Medium
